_comment: Upstream software this dashboard depends on but does not vendor.
scripts/bootstrap.sh installs these on the mirror.
Pinned refs keep a rebuild reproducible -- bump them deliberately, not by accident.

unresolved.name: MMT-CalmCurrentWeather
unresolved.reason: Referenced by config/config.js as the current-weather themeDir, but no source is present in this repo and no upstream was recorded. It exists only on the mirror at /opt/MagicMirror/modules/. Recover it with scripts/pull-from-pi.sh before rebuilding the mirror from scratch.

unresolved.name: MMM-DirectClock, MMM-ReferenceClock
unresolved.reason: Listed in the old INSTALLED_MODULES.txt but not referenced by config/config.js. Abandoned clock experiments, superseded by clock/magicmirror-python-clock.py. Not installed by bootstrap.
